## Introduction

This report documents my successful completion of the CITI Program's human subjects research training, as required for IC8-2. The training covers research ethics, informed consent, privacy and confidentiality, and responsible research practices.

## Training Information

| Item | Details |
|:--|:--|
| Institution | California State Polytechnic University, Pomona |
| Curriculum Group | Human Research |
| Course Learner Group | College of Business Administration |
| Stage | 1 - Basic Course |
| Completion Date | October 9, 2026 |
| Expiration Date | October 9, 2031 |
| Minimum Passing Score | 80% |
| Reported Score | 99% |
| Status | Completed |
